The Prep Cook 2 is responsible for supporting the daily food preparation and production requirements of the Staff Cafeteria.

This role ensures that high standards of food quality, hygiene, and presentation are maintained while assisting in the preparation of meals for employees. The Prep Cook 2 works closely with the culinary team to deliver efficient and timely service in accordance with company standards and food safety regulations.
q: Previous experience in a kitchen or food preparation role, preferably within a hotel, restaurant, or staff cafeteria environment.
Basic knowledge of food preparation techniques, food safety, and kitchen hygiene practices.
Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment while maintaining quality standards.
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
Ability to follow recipes, instructions, and standard operating procedures.
Ability to stand for extended periods and perform physically demanding tasks, including lifting and carrying supplies.
Flexibility to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays as required.
Basic understanding of HACCP and food safety regulations is preferred.
Culinary qualification or relevant vocational training is an advantage.
Positive attitude, willingness to learn, and commitment to maintaining high standards of service and cleanliness.
